hi.R: यीशु ने आगे कहा, "तुम बड़े चालाक हो! तुम परमेश्वर की आज्ञा को टालने के रास्ते ढूँढ़ लेते हो, ताकि अपने नियम मान सको।

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} казав їм: «Добре ж ви відкидаєте заповідь Божу, щоб дотримати вашого передання.
uk.B: І далі сказав: «Як вправно ви відкладаєте Божу заповідь, щоб зберегти своє передання!
uk.R: Ісус говорив далі: «Ви дуже хитрі! Ви знаходите способи не зважати на те, що наказує Бог, щоб дотримуватися своїх правил.

ja.L: また、イエスは彼らに言っておられた。「あなたがたは、自分たちの言い伝えを守るために、見事に神の戒めを退けている。
ja.B: イエスはさらに言われた。「あなたがたは、自分たちの言い伝えを守るためなら、実に巧みに神の戒めをわきに置くものだ。
ja.R: イエスは続けて言われました。「あなたたちは本当に頭がいい！自分たちの決まりを守るために、うまく神のおきてを無視している。

decisions.choice: well: said with irony, how cleverly
decisions.reason: The same word as in 7:6, now turned against them: they are skilled at the wrong thing.

decisions.choice: set aside: reject, treat as void
decisions.reason: The verb is used for refusing or cancelling something that has force.

decisions.choice: keep, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read "establish" your tradition. The two words differ by little in Greek. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: very skillful (B); very clever (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the irony of "well" plain.

decisions.choice: "khéo" (L); "thật khéo léo" (B); "thật là khôn khéo" (R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "khéo" can praise or mock, so it carries the irony of the Greek "well" (meaning decision) without a word that sounds like plain praise.

decisions.choice: "잘도" for the ironic "well"
decisions.reason: Korean "잘도" carries the irony of the Greek "well" (how cleverly) while keeping the word; plain "잘" would sound like praise.

decisions.choice: Bien (L); ¡Qué hábiles ...! (B); ¡Qué astutos! (R)
decisions.reason: The word is ironic (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the plain "bien"; Balanced and Readable make the irony plain with an exclamation.

decisions.choice: a própria tradição
decisions.reason: With "vocês", "sua" could be read as "his" or "their"; "a própria tradição" says plainly that it is their own, which is also the stress of the English "your own".

decisions.choice: "በሚገባ" (L); "እንዴት የተካናችሁ ናችሁ" (B); "በጣም ብልጦች ናችሁ" (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus' "well" is ironic. Plain "መልካም" would sound like praise; "በሚገባ" (thoroughly) keeps the Greek's single adverb at Literal, and Balanced and Readable make the irony plain with "skilled" and "shrewd" ("ብልጥ" carries a hint of cunning).
Literal keeps the ironic "well" with a word that in Hindi can praise and mock at once; Balanced and Readable make the irony plain, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "見事に" (L); "実に巧みに" (B); "本当に頭がいい" (R); "言っておられた" (L)
decisions.reason: The word of 7:6 returns with irony (m1); Literal repeats "見事に" so the echo can be heard, and Balanced and Readable make the irony plain, as the English does. Literal gives the imperfect "was saying" as "言っておられた", the respect form of 言っていた; Balanced and Readable say "言われた".

source.text: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ εἶπεν· Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου, καί· Ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα θανάτῳ τελευτάτω·

records.literal_gloss: Moses for said, Honor the father of you and the mother of you, and, The [one] speaking evil of father or mother by death let him end.

en.L: For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and, 'Whoever speaks evil of father or mother must surely die.'
en.B: For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and also, 'Whoever reviles father or mother is to die for it.'
en.R: Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother.' He also said, 'Anyone who says evil things against their father or mother is to be put to death.'

vi.L: Vì Môi-se đã nói: 'Hãy tôn kính cha mình và mẹ mình,' và: 'Kẻ nào nói xấu cha hoặc mẹ thì phải chết.'
vi.B: Vì Môi-se đã nói: 'Hãy tôn kính cha mẹ mình,' và: 'Ai chửi rủa cha hoặc mẹ phải bị xử tử.'
vi.R: Môi-se đã nói: 'Hãy tôn kính cha mẹ mình.' Ông cũng nói: 'Ai nói những lời độc ác xúc phạm cha hoặc mẹ mình thì phải bị xử tử.'

ko.L: 모세가 '네 아버지와 네 어머니를 공경하여라' 하고 말하였고, 또 '아버지나 어머니를 악하게 말하는 사람은 반드시 죽어야 한다' 하고 말하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 모세는 '네 아버지와 어머니를 공경하여라' 했고, 또 '아버지나 어머니를 모욕하는 사람은 반드시 사형에 처해야 한다' 했다.
ko.R: 모세는 '너희 아버지와 어머니를 공경하여라' 하고 말했다. 또 '자기 아버지나 어머니를 나쁘게 말하는 사람은 사형에 처해야 한다' 하고 말했다.

es.L: Porque Moisés dijo: “Honra a tu padre y a tu madre”, y: “El que hable mal de padre o de madre, que muera sin remedio”.
es.B: Porque Moisés dijo: “Honra a tu padre y a tu madre”, y también: “El que insulte a su padre o a su madre será condenado a muerte”.
es.R: Moisés dijo: “Honra a tu padre y a tu madre”. También dijo: “Al que hable mal de su padre o de su madre, hay que darle muerte”.

fr.L: Car Moïse a dit : “Honore ton père et ta mère”, et : “Celui qui dit du mal de [son] père ou de [sa] mère doit être puni de mort.”
fr.B: Moïse a dit en effet : “Honore ton père et ta mère”, et aussi : “Celui qui insulte son père ou sa mère doit être mis à mort.”
fr.R: Moïse a dit : “Honore ton père et ta mère.” Il a dit aussi : “Celui qui dit du mal de son père ou de sa mère doit être puni de mort.”

sw.L: Kwa maana Musa alisema, 'Mheshimu baba yako na mama yako,' na, 'Anayesema maovu juu ya baba au mama, lazima afe.'
sw.B: Kwa maana Musa alisema, 'Mheshimu baba yako na mama yako,' na tena, 'Mtu anayemtukana baba au mama yake na auawe.'
sw.R: Musa alisema, 'Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.' Pia alisema, 'Mtu yeyote anayesema maneno mabaya dhidi ya baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.'

pt.L: Pois Moisés disse: 'Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe', e: 'Quem falar mal do pai ou da mãe certamente morrerá.'
pt.B: Pois Moisés disse: 'Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe', e também: 'Quem insultar o pai ou a mãe deve ser morto.'
pt.R: Moisés disse: 'Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe.' E também disse: 'Quem falar mal do pai ou da mãe deve ser morto.'

am.L: ሙሴ፦ “አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር” ብሏልና፤ ደግሞም፦ “አባትን ወይም እናትን የሚሳደብ ሞትን ይሙት” [ብሏል]።
am.B: ሙሴ፦ “አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር” ብሏልና፤ ደግሞም፦ “አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚሰድብ ሁሉ ይገደል” ብሏል።
am.R: ሙሴ፦ “አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር” ብሏል። ደግሞም፦ “አባቱን ወይም እናቱን ክፉ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይገደል” ብሏል።

ru.L: Ведь Моисей сказал: “Почитай твоего отца и твою мать”, и: “Кто злословит отца или мать, пусть непременно умрёт.”
ru.B: Ведь Моисей сказал: “Почитай своего отца и свою мать”, и ещё: “Кто поносит отца или мать, должен быть предан смерти.”
ru.R: Моисей сказал: “Почитай своего отца и свою мать.” Он также сказал: “Того, кто говорит плохое о своём отце или матери, нужно предать смерти.”

hi.L: क्योंकि मूसा ने कहा, 'अपने पिता और अपनी माता का सम्मान करो,' और, 'जो पिता या माता की निंदा करे, वह अवश्य मार डाला जाए।'
hi.B: क्योंकि मूसा ने कहा, 'अपने पिता और अपनी माता का सम्मान करो,' और यह भी, 'जो कोई पिता या माता को कोसे, उसे मृत्युदंड दिया जाए।'
hi.R: मूसा ने कहा, 'अपने पिता और अपनी माँ का आदर करो।' उसने यह भी कहा, 'जो कोई अपने पिता या अपनी माँ के बारे में बुरी बातें कहे, उसे मार डाला जाए।'

uk.L: Бо Мойсей сказав: “Шануй свого батька і свою матір”, і: “Хто лихословить батька чи матір, хай смертю помре.”
uk.B: Адже Мойсей сказав: “Шануй свого батька і свою матір”, а також: “Хто зневажає батька чи матір, має бути покараний смертю.”
uk.R: Мойсей сказав: “Шануй свого батька і свою матір.” Він також сказав: “Кожен, хто говорить лихе про свого батька чи матір, має бути покараний смертю.”

ja.L: モーセは、『あなたの父とあなたの母を敬え』と言い、また、『父または母をののしる者は、必ず死ななければならない』と言ったからである。
ja.B: 実際、モーセは『あなたの父と母を敬え』と言い、さらに『父や母をののしる者は死刑に処されなければならない』と言った。
ja.R: モーセは『あなたの父と母を大切にしなさい』と言った。また、『自分の父や母の悪口を言う者は、死刑にされなければならない』とも言った。

decisions.choice: honor your father and your mother: the fifth commandment, Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16
decisions.reason: Jesus calls the commandment the word of Moses here and the word of God in 7:13.

decisions.choice: whoever speaks evil of father or mother: Exodus 21:17; Leviticus 20:9
decisions.reason: The law treated cursing a parent as a crime deserving death.

decisions.choice: honor: respect, and also support and care for parents in old age
decisions.reason: Honoring parents included providing for them. This is the point of the example in 7:11-12.

decisions.choice: end by death: surely die, be put to death
decisions.reason: The words copy a Hebrew way of speaking that stresses certainty. The law means the death penalty.

decisions.choice: reviles
decisions.reason: The verb means to speak evil of someone, to abuse with words.

decisions.choice: "cha mình và mẹ mình" (L); "cha mẹ mình" (B, R) for "your father and your mother"
decisions.reason: "Ngươi" is archaic, and "con" or "anh" would fix a relation that the commandment, said to every reader, does not have; the reflexive "mình" speaks to whoever hears it. Balanced and Readable use the usual pair "cha mẹ".

decisions.choice: que muera sin remedio (L); será condenado a muerte (B); hay que darle muerte (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew way of saying "he shall surely die" (meaning decision m4); each level says it in plain Spanish, without the old "morirá de muerte".

decisions.choice: "doit être puni de mort" (L, R); "doit être mis à mort" (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek "let him end by death" is an idiom for a sure death sentence (meaning decision); a word-for-word "mourir de mort" is not French, so every level states the penalty.

decisions.choice: Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe, with "tu"
alternatives: Honre o seu pai e a sua mãe
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the Pharisees with "vocês", but the commandment he quotes keeps the "tu" in which God gives the Law, at every level, as in Matthew 15:4 (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4). Balanced and Readable keep the wording of Matthew 15:4 for the second law.

decisions.choice: "敬え" (L, B), "大切にしなさい" (R); "必ず死ななければならない" (L), "死刑に処されなければならない" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Quoted law keeps the plain command at Literal and Balanced; Readable's "大切にしなさい" includes the care for parents that the command meant (m3). The Hebrew idiom "end by death" means the death penalty (m4).

source.text: ὑμεῖς δὲ λέγετε· Ἐὰν εἴπῃ ἄνθρωπος τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί· Κορβᾶν, ὅ ἐστιν Δῶρον, ὃ ἐὰν ἐξ ἐμοῦ ὠφεληθῇς, οὐκέτι ἀφίετε αὐτὸν οὐδὲν ποιῆσαι τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί, ἀκυροῦντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ παραδόσει ὑμῶν ᾗ παρεδώκατε· καὶ παρόμοια τοιαῦτα πολλὰ ποιεῖτε.

records.literal_gloss: You but say, If says a man to the father or the mother, Corban, which is, Gift, whatever from me you might be benefited, \v 12 no longer you allow him anything to do for the father or the mother, \v 13 making void the word of the God by the tradition of you which you handed down; and similar such things many you do.

en.L: But you say, 'If a person says to father or mother, "Whatever you might have gained from me [is] Corban," which is, a gift [to God],' \v 12 you no longer let that person do anything for father or mother, \v 13 making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down; and you do many similar things such as these."
en.B: But you teach that if someone tells father or mother, 'Whatever support you could have had from me is Corban' (which means an offering to God), \v 12 then you no longer let that person do anything for their father or mother. \v 13 You make God's word empty for the sake of the tradition you hand down, and you do plenty of other things of the same kind."
en.R: But you teach something else. You say that a person can tell their father or mother, 'I cannot help you, because what I would have given you is Corban.' Corban means a gift set apart for God. \v 12 After that, you will not let them do anything to help their father or mother. \v 13 So by keeping the rules you pass down, you make God's word count for nothing. And you do many other things like that."

vi.L: Nhưng các người nói: 'Nếu một người nói với cha hoặc mẹ: "Bất cứ điều gì cha mẹ có thể được con giúp, là Cọt-ban," nghĩa là của lễ [dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời],' \v 12 thì các người không còn để người ấy làm gì cho cha hoặc mẹ nữa, \v 13 [như vậy] làm cho lời Đức Chúa Trời ra vô hiệu bởi truyền thống mà các người đã truyền lại; và các người làm nhiều điều tương tự như thế."
vi.B: Nhưng các người lại dạy rằng nếu ai nói với cha hoặc mẹ: 'Những gì con có thể giúp cha mẹ đều là Cọt-ban' (nghĩa là của lễ dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời), \v 12 thì các người không cho người ấy làm gì cho cha mẹ mình nữa. \v 13 Như vậy, vì truyền thống các người truyền lại, các người làm cho lời Đức Chúa Trời ra vô hiệu. Các người còn làm nhiều điều khác giống như thế."
vi.R: Nhưng các người lại dạy khác. Các người nói rằng một người có thể nói với cha mẹ mình: 'Con không giúp cha mẹ được, vì những gì con định biếu cha mẹ là Cọt-ban.' Cọt-ban nghĩa là của lễ đã dành riêng cho Đức Chúa Trời. \v 12 Sau đó, các người không cho người ấy làm gì để giúp cha mẹ mình nữa. \v 13 Như vậy, vì giữ những luật lệ các người truyền lại, các người làm cho lời Đức Chúa Trời trở thành vô giá trị. Các người còn làm nhiều việc khác giống như thế."

ko.L: 그런데 너희는 말한다. '누구든지 아버지나 어머니에게 "제게서 받으실 수 있는 것은 무엇이든 고르반, 곧 [하나님께 드린] 예물입니다" 하고 말하면,' \v 12 너희는 그 사람이 아버지나 어머니를 위하여 더 이상 아무것도 하지 못하게 한다. \v 13 이렇게 너희는 너희가 전해 준 너희 전통으로 하나님의 말씀을 무효로 만든다. 그리고 너희는 이와 비슷한 일들을 많이 한다."
ko.B: 그러나 너희는 이렇게 가르친다. 누구든지 아버지나 어머니에게 '제가 드릴 수 있었던 도움은 무엇이든 고르반입니다' 하고 말하면(고르반은 하나님께 바친 예물이라는 뜻이다), \v 12 너희는 그 사람이 더 이상 아버지나 어머니를 위해 아무것도 하지 못하게 한다. \v 13 너희는 이렇게 너희가 물려주는 전통을 내세워 하나님의 말씀을 헛되게 만든다. 그리고 이와 비슷한 일을 많이 한다."
ko.R: 그런데 너희는 다르게 가르친다. 누구든지 아버지나 어머니에게 '제가 도와 드리려던 것은 고르반이어서 도와 드릴 수 없습니다' 하고 말해도 된다고 한다. 고르반은 하나님께 바치려고 따로 떼어 놓은 선물이라는 뜻이다. \v 12 그렇게 말하고 나면, 너희는 그 사람이 아버지나 어머니를 돕지 못하게 한다. \v 13 이렇게 너희는 너희가 물려주는 규칙을 지키느라 하나님의 말씀을 쓸모없게 만든다. 그리고 이런 일을 그 밖에도 많이 한다."

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: “Si alguien dice al padre o a la madre: ‘Es corbán (es decir, ofrenda [a Dios]) cualquier ayuda que pudieras recibir de mí’”, \v 12 ya no le {{plural_you:dejan|dejáis}} hacer nada por el padre o la madre, \v 13 anulando la palabra de Dios con {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tradición que {{plural_you:han transmitido|habéis transmitido}}. Y {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} muchas cosas parecidas a estas».
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes enseñan|vosotros enseñáis}} que, si alguien le dice a su padre o a su madre: “Cualquier ayuda que pudieras recibir de mí es corbán” (es decir, una ofrenda para Dios), \v 12 entonces ya no le {{plural_you:permiten|permitís}} hacer nada por su padre o por su madre. \v 13 Así {{plural_you:anulan|anuláis}} la palabra de Dios por causa de la tradición que {{plural_you:transmiten|transmitís}}, y {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} muchas otras cosas parecidas».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes enseñan|vosotros enseñáis}} otra cosa. {{plural_you:Dicen|Decís}} que una persona puede decirle a su padre o a su madre: “No puedo ayudarte, porque lo que te habría dado es corbán”. Corbán quiere decir un regalo apartado para Dios. \v 12 Después de eso, ya no le {{plural_you:dejan|dejáis}} hacer nada para ayudar a su padre o a su madre. \v 13 Así, por cumplir las reglas que {{plural_you:se pasan|os pasáis}} de unos a otros, {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} que la palabra de Dios no valga nada. Y {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} muchas otras cosas como esa».

fr.L: Mais vous, vous dites : “Si {{gender:une personne|un homme}} dit à [son] père ou à [sa] mère : ‘Ce dont tu aurais pu profiter de ma part [est] Corban’, c’est-à-dire offrande [à Dieu]”, \v 12 vous ne lui permettez plus de rien faire pour [son] père ou [sa] mère, \v 13 annulant la parole de Dieu par votre tradition, que vous avez transmise ; et vous faites beaucoup de choses semblables à celles-là. »
fr.B: Mais vous, vous enseignez que si quelqu’un dit à son père ou à sa mère : “L’aide que tu aurais pu recevoir de moi est Corban” (c’est-à-dire offrande à Dieu), \v 12 alors vous ne lui permettez plus de rien faire pour son père ou sa mère. \v 13 Ainsi vous videz la parole de Dieu de sa force au profit de la tradition que vous transmettez. Et vous faites bien d’autres choses du même genre. »
fr.R: Mais vous, vous enseignez autre chose. Vous dites que quelqu’un peut dire à son père ou à sa mère : “Je ne peux pas t’aider, parce que ce que je t’aurais donné est Corban.” Corban veut dire un don réservé à Dieu. \v 12 Après cela, vous ne laissez plus cette personne aider son père ou sa mère. \v 13 Ainsi, en suivant les règles que vous transmettez, vous enlevez toute valeur à la parole de Dieu. Et vous faites beaucoup d’autres choses de ce genre. »

sw.L: Lakini ninyi mnasema, 'Mtu akimwambia baba au mama, "Chochote ambacho ungefaidika nacho kutoka kwangu [ni] Korbani," yaani, zawadi [kwa Mungu],' \v 12 hammruhusu tena kufanya lolote kwa ajili ya baba au mama, \v 13 mkilitangua neno la Mungu kwa mapokeo yenu mliyoyapokeza; na mnafanya mambo mengi yanayofanana na hayo."
sw.B: Lakini ninyi mnafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba au mama yake, 'Msaada wowote ambao ungepata kutoka kwangu ni Korbani' (maana yake, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Mungu), \v 12 basi hammruhusu tena kufanya chochote kwa ajili ya baba au mama yake. \v 13 Mnalifanya neno la Mungu kuwa bure kwa ajili ya mapokeo mnayoyapokezana, na mnafanya mambo mengine mengi ya namna hiyo."
sw.R: Lakini ninyi mnafundisha jambo lingine. Mnasema kwamba mtu anaweza kumwambia baba yake au mama yake, 'Siwezi kukusaidia, kwa sababu kile ambacho ningekupa ni Korbani.' Korbani maana yake ni zawadi iliyotengwa kwa ajili ya Mungu. \v 12 Baada ya hapo hammruhusu tena mtu huyo kufanya lolote kuwasaidia baba yake au mama yake. \v 13 Hivyo kwa kushika kanuni mnazopokezana, mnalifanya neno la Mungu kuwa si kitu. Nanyi mnafanya mambo mengine mengi kama hayo."

pt.L: Mas vocês dizem: 'Se alguém disser ao pai ou à mãe: "Qualquer ajuda que você poderia ter de mim [é] Corbã", o que quer dizer, oferta [a Deus]', \v 12 vocês já não deixam essa pessoa fazer nada pelo pai ou pela mãe, \v 13 anulando a palavra de Deus pela tradição de vocês, que vocês transmitiram; e fazem muitas outras coisas semelhantes a essas."
pt.B: Mas vocês ensinam que, se alguém disser ao pai ou à mãe: 'Todo o sustento que você poderia receber de mim é Corbã' (que quer dizer oferta a Deus), \v 12 então vocês já não deixam essa pessoa fazer nada pelo pai ou pela mãe. \v 13 Vocês esvaziam a palavra de Deus por causa da tradição que vocês transmitem, e fazem muitas outras coisas do mesmo tipo."
pt.R: Mas vocês ensinam outra coisa. Vocês dizem que uma pessoa pode dizer ao pai ou à mãe: 'Não posso ajudar você, porque o que eu daria a você é Corbã.' Corbã quer dizer uma oferta separada para Deus. \v 12 Depois disso, vocês não deixam essa pessoa fazer mais nada para ajudar o pai ou a mãe. \v 13 Assim, para seguir as regras que vocês passam adiante, vocês fazem a palavra de Deus não valer nada. E vocês fazem muitas outras coisas assim."

am.L: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ ትላላችሁ፦ “ሰው ለአባቱ ወይም ለእናቱ፦ ‘ከእኔ የምትጠቀመው ማናቸውም ነገር ቁርባን ነው’ ቢል፣ ይህም መባ [ለእግዚአብሔር] ማለት ነው፤” \v 12 ከዚያ በኋላ ለአባቱ ወይም ለእናቱ አንዳች ነገር እንዲያደርግ አትፈቅዱለትም፤ \v 13 ባስተላለፋችሁትም ወጋችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ትሽራላችሁ፤ እንደዚህ ያሉ ብዙ ተመሳሳይ ነገሮችንም ታደርጋላችሁ።»
am.B: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ ታስተምራላችሁ፤ ማንም ሰው ለአባቱ ወይም ለእናቱ “ከእኔ ልታገኘው የምትችለው እርዳታ ሁሉ ቁርባን ነው” (ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የተሰጠ መባ ማለት ነው) ቢል፣ \v 12 ከዚያ በኋላ ያ ሰው ለአባቱ ወይም ለእናቱ ምንም ነገር እንዲያደርግ አትፈቅዱለትም። \v 13 በምታስተላልፉት ወግ ምክንያት የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ከንቱ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ይህን የመሰሉ ሌሎች ብዙ ነገሮችንም ታደርጋላችሁ።»
am.R: እናንተ ግን ሌላ ነገር ታስተምራላችሁ። አንድ ሰው አባቱን ወይም እናቱን “ልረዳችሁ አልችልም፤ ልሰጣችሁ የነበረው ቁርባን ነውና” ማለት ይችላል ትላላችሁ። ቁርባን ማለት ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየ ስጦታ ማለት ነው። \v 12 ከዚያ በኋላ አባቱን ወይም እናቱን በምንም ነገር እንዲረዳ አትፈቅዱለትም። \v 13 ስለዚህ የምታስተላልፉትን ሥርዓት በመጠበቅ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ከንቱ ታደርጋላችሁ። እንደዚህ ያሉ ሌሎች ብዙ ነገሮችንም ታደርጋላችሁ።»

ru.L: А вы говорите: “Если человек скажет отцу или матери: ‘Чем бы ты от меня ни воспользовался, [это] корбан’, что значит дар [Богу]”, \v 12 то вы уже не позволяете ему ничего сделать для отца или матери, \v 13 отменяя слово Божье вашим преданием, которое вы передали; и много подобного этому вы делаете.»
ru.B: А вы учите, что если кто-то скажет отцу или матери: “Всё, чем я мог бы тебе помочь, — корбан” (что значит: приношение Богу), \v 12 то вы уже не позволяете этому человеку ничего сделать для отца или матери. \v 13 Так ради предания, которое вы передаёте, вы лишаете Божье слово силы. И многое другое в том же роде вы делаете.»
ru.R: Но вы учите другому. Вы говорите, что человек может сказать отцу или матери: “Я не могу тебе помочь, потому что то, что я дал бы тебе, — корбан.” Корбан значит дар, отданный Богу. \v 12 После этого вы уже не позволяете ему ничего сделать для отца или матери. \v 13 Так, соблюдая правила, которые вы передаёте, вы превращаете Божье слово в ничто. И много другого подобного вы делаете.»

hi.L: परंतु तुम कहते हो, 'यदि कोई मनुष्य पिता या माता से कहे, "जो कुछ आपको मुझसे लाभ मिल सकता था, वह कुरबान [है]," अर्थात् [परमेश्वर को] भेंट,' \v 12 तो तुम उसे पिता या माता के लिए फिर कुछ भी करने नहीं देते, \v 13 और इस तरह अपनी परंपरा से, जो तुमने आगे सौंपी है, परमेश्वर के वचन को व्यर्थ कर देते हो; और ऐसे ही बहुत-से और काम तुम करते हो।"
hi.B: परंतु तुम सिखाते हो कि यदि कोई अपने पिता या माता से कहे, 'जो सहायता आपको मुझसे मिल सकती थी, वह कुरबान है' (अर्थात् परमेश्वर के लिए भेंट), \v 12 तो फिर तुम उसे अपने पिता या माता के लिए कुछ भी करने नहीं देते। \v 13 इस तरह अपनी परंपरा की ख़ातिर, जिसे तुम आगे सौंपते हो, तुम परमेश्वर के वचन को रद्द कर देते हो। और ऐसे ही बहुत-से दूसरे काम भी तुम करते हो।"
hi.R: परंतु तुम कुछ और ही सिखाते हो। तुम कहते हो कि कोई अपने पिता या माता से कह सकता है, 'मैं आपकी मदद नहीं कर सकता, क्योंकि जो मैं आपको देता, वह कुरबान है।' कुरबान का मतलब है परमेश्वर के लिए अलग की गई भेंट। \v 12 उसके बाद तुम उसे अपने पिता या माता की मदद के लिए कुछ भी करने नहीं देते। \v 13 इस तरह अपने नियमों को आगे सौंपते हुए तुम परमेश्वर के वचन को बेकार बना देते हो। और तुम ऐसे बहुत-से दूसरे काम भी करते हो।"

uk.L: А ви кажете: “Якщо людина скаже батькові чи матері: ‘Те, чим ти міг би скористатися від мене, — корван’, тобто дар [Богові]”, \v 12 ви вже не дозволяєте їй нічого зробити для батька чи матері, \v 13 скасовуючи слово Боже вашим переданням, яке ви передали; і багато подібного такого робите.»
uk.B: А ви навчаєте: якщо хтось скаже батькові чи матері: “Те, чим я міг би тобі допомогти, — корван” (тобто дар Богові), \v 12 то ви вже не дозволяєте йому нічого зробити для батька чи матері. \v 13 Так ви робите Боже слово порожнім заради передання, яке передаєте далі, і чините ще багато чого подібного.»
uk.R: А ви навчаєте іншого. Ви кажете, що людина може сказати батькові чи матері: “Я не можу тобі допомогти, бо те, що я міг би тобі дати, — корван.” Корван означає дар, відданий Богові. \v 12 Після цього ви не дозволяєте їй нічим допомогти батькові чи матері. \v 13 Тож, дотримуючись правил, які ви передаєте, ви робите Боже слово нічого не вартим. І ви робите ще багато такого.»

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたは言う。『人が父または母に、「あなたがわたしから得られたはずのものは何でも、コルバン[です]」と言うなら』――コルバンとは[神への]ささげ物ということである――、\v 12 あなたがたは、もはやその人に、父または母のために何もさせない。\v 13 こうしてあなたがたは、自分たちが伝えてきた言い伝えによって神の言葉を無効にしている。また、これと同じようなことを数多く行っている。」
ja.B: ところが、あなたがたはこう教えている。人が父や母に向かって、『あなたがわたしから受けられたはずの援助は、コルバンです』と言えば（コルバンとは神へのささげ物という意味である）、\v 12 あなたがたは、その人にもはや父や母のために何もさせない。\v 13 こうして、あなたがたは、自分たちが受け継いできた言い伝えのために神の言葉をむなしくしている。また、これと同じようなことをほかにもたくさん行っている。」
ja.R: しかし、あなたたちは別のことを教えている。人が父や母に、『わたしがあなたにあげるはずだったものはコルバンなので、あなたを助けることはできない』と言ってもよい、と言うのだ。コルバンとは、神のために取り分けたささげ物という意味だ。\v 12 そのあと、あなたたちは、その人が父や母を助けることを何一つ許さない。\v 13 こうして、自分たちが伝えている決まりを守ることで、神の言葉を無にしている。ほかにも、同じようなことをたくさんしている。」

decisions.choice: Corban: a word for an offering dedicated to God, kept and translated by Mark
decisions.reason: The word is used in the law of Moses for an offering brought to God (Leviticus 2:1). A man could declare his goods Corban, set apart for God, and so put them beyond his parents' reach, while he may still have kept the use of them.

decisions.choice: the sentence is left unfinished: Jesus states their rule, then says what follows from it
decisions.reason: The teachers' rule is "if anyone says Corban, the vow stands". Jesus breaks off and states the result: you no longer allow him to help his parents.

decisions.choice: making void: cancelling, taking away the force of
decisions.reason: The word was used for annulling a law or a contract.

decisions.choice: the word of God: the commandment Moses gave (7:10)
decisions.reason: What Moses said in 7:10 Jesus calls the word of God, set against the tradition handed down by people.

decisions.choice: Corban, kept as Mark keeps it
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it, so every level does the same.

decisions.choice: I cannot help you, because
decisions.reason: Readable says what the vow meant for the parents.

decisions.choice: "Cọt-ban"
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it; Vietnamese keeps it too, in the transliteration the Protestant tradition uses, followed by Mark's explanation.

decisions.choice: The son speaks to his parent as "cha mẹ" and of himself as "con"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a pronoun for the singular "you" and for "me"; a child speaking to a father or mother says "cha mẹ" and "con". "Cha mẹ" also covers "father or mother" without naming one.

decisions.choice: "고르반", the Protestant spelling of Corban, kept at every level
decisions.reason: Korean readers know the word in this form; Mark explains it himself, and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: The son speaks to his parents in 합쇼체 ("제게서", "예물입니다")
decisions.reason: A grown child speaking a formal vow to father or mother would use the deferential style; this keeps the quoted vow polite while its content is harsh.

decisions.choice: corbán
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it (meaning decision m1); Spanish does the same, writing it in lower case as an ordinary word.

decisions.choice: ‘ ’ inside “ ” inside « »
decisions.reason: The vow quoted inside the Pharisees' teaching, which is quoted inside Jesus's words, takes a third level of quotation marks, as in John 10:34.

decisions.choice: {{gender:une personne|un homme}} (L); "quelqu’un" with no setting (B, R)
alternatives: no setting at Literal, as in English
decisions.reason: The Greek has the noun for a human being; French Literal needs a noun for it, so the gender setting goes there, with the traditional "un homme" as the alternative. The pronoun "lui" that follows is the same for both. Balanced and Readable say "quelqu’un", already inclusive.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks ‘ ’ for the words spoken inside the quoted rule
decisions.reason: Literal keeps three levels of speech (Jesus, their rule, the son’s vow). French uses « » and then “ ”; the third level takes ‘ ’ so the reader can see where the vow ends. Balanced and Readable need only two levels.

decisions.choice: Korbani
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the word and explains it (meaning decision), so Swahili keeps it too, with the final -i that Swahili gives to borrowed names (as Beelzebuli in 3:22).

decisions.choice: Corbã
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the word and explains it, so every level keeps it too, in the Portuguese spelling of the Aramaic sounds, as with the other Aramaic words in Mark (5:41; 7:34; 15:34).

decisions.choice: você (the son to his father or mother)
decisions.reason: The words are a formula the son speaks to one parent; Portuguese uses "você", as Matthew 15:5 does, since the story does not stress the son's respect but his evasion.

decisions.choice: "ቁርባን" kept, with Mark's explanation
alternatives: "ቆርባን", a spelling that marks it as a foreign word
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it, so Amharic keeps it too. "ቁርባን" is the same word that came into Ge'ez as "offering"; Ethiopian readers know it as the name of the Lord's Supper, so the explanation ("an offering to God") is translated at every level to keep that sense from intruding.

decisions.choice: "корбан"
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it, so every level does the same. "Корбан" is the modern transcription of the word.

decisions.choice: "कुरबान", kept as Mark keeps it
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it, so every level does the same. The word also sounds like the Hindi "क़ुर्बान" (sacrificed), which helps the reader.

decisions.choice: "आपको" from a child to a parent
decisions.reason: In Hindi a son or daughter speaks to a father or mother with आप, as in Matthew 15:5.

decisions.choice: "корван", lowercase, as a word Mark explains
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word for an offering and translates it; Ukrainian writes it as a common noun, as with other borrowed words, followed by its meaning.

decisions.choice: "コルバン" kept, with Mark's explanation "ささげ物"
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the Hebrew word and explains it (m1), so every level writes it in katakana and keeps his explanation, as the Gospel terms do for the Aramaic phrases.

decisions.choice: Mark's explanation set off with dashes after the quotation, and the rule left unfinished
decisions.reason: Jesus breaks off the teachers' rule and states its result (m2); Literal keeps the broken sentence, and the dashes keep Mark's gloss from reading as part of the vow.

source.text: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος πάλιν τὸν ὄχλον ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀκούσατέ μου πάντες καὶ σύνετε.

records.literal_gloss: And having called to [him] again the crowd he was saying to them, Hear me all and understand.

en.L: And calling the crowd to [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] again, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying to them, "Hear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, all [of you], and understand:
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called the crowd to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} once more and said, "Hear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, every one of you, and understand this:
en.R: Then Jesus called the crowd to come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} again. He said, "Everyone, listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and try to understand.

vi.L: Và gọi đoàn dân đến [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] một lần nữa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Hết thảy các người hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và hiểu:
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại gọi đoàn dân đến và nói: "Tất cả các người hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và hiểu điều này:
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu lại gọi đoàn dân đến gần. Ngài nói: "Mọi người hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và cố gắng hiểu.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 다시 무리를 [가까이] 불러 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 모두 내 말을 듣고 깨달아라.
ko.B: 예수께서 다시 무리를 가까이 부르시고 말씀하셨다. "너희는 모두 내 말을 듣고 깨달아라.
ko.R: 예수께서 사람들을 다시 가까이 부르셨다. 그리고 말씀하셨다. "모두 내 말을 잘 듣고, 깨달으려고 애써 보아라.

es.L: Y llamando otra vez a la multitud, les decía: «{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} todos, y {{plural_you:entiendan|entended}}:
es.B: Luego llamó de nuevo a la multitud y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} todos, y {{plural_you:entiendan|entended}} esto:
es.R: Entonces Jesús volvió a llamar a la gente para que se acercara a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} todos y {{plural_you:traten|tratad}} de entender.

fr.L: Et ayant appelé de nouveau la foule, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tous, et comprenez.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} appela de nouveau la foule et dit : « Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous tous, et comprenez bien ceci :
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus a de nouveau appelé la foule. Il a dit : « Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous tous, et essayez de comprendre.

sw.L: Na akiuita umati tena [uje] {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, alikuwa akiwaambia, "Nisikilizeni, nyote, na mwelewe:
sw.B: Kisha akauita umati tena uje {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, akasema, "Nisikilizeni, kila mmoja wenu, mwelewe jambo hili:
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akauita umati wa watu uje {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} tena. Akasema, "Nisikilizeni nyote, na jitahidini kuelewa.

pt.L: E, chamando de novo a multidão para junto [de {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}}], {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes dizia: "Ouçam-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, todos [vocês], e entendam:
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} chamou de novo a multidão para perto de {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} e disse: "Ouçam-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, todos vocês, e entendam isto:
pt.R: Então Jesus chamou a multidão outra vez para chegar perto {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Ele disse: "Escutem-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, todos vocês, e procurem entender.

am.L: ደግሞም ሕዝቡን [ወደ እርሱ] ጠርቶ እንዲህ ይላቸው ነበር፦ «ሁላችሁ ስሙኝ፤ አስተውሉም።

decisions.choice: again: once more Jesus calls the crowd to hear
alternatives: the crowd had been there all along
decisions.reason: The crowd were last named in 6:55-56. Jesus now turns from the Pharisees to teach everyone.

decisions.choice: understand: grasp the meaning
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 4:12 and 6:52. The disciples will show in 7:18 that they have not understood.

decisions.choice: try to understand
decisions.reason: Readable shows that this is a call to think carefully.

decisions.choice: "Mọi người" (R) for "all of you"
decisions.reason: Readable addresses the crowd with the neutral "mọi người" (everyone), which a plain reader hears as an invitation; Literal and Balanced keep the book's "các người".

decisions.choice: llamando ... a la multitud
decisions.reason: Spanish "llamar" already means calling someone to oneself, so Literal needs no bracketed "to him".

decisions.choice: "悟りなさい" (L, B); "よく考えて分かるようにしなさい" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of 4:12 and 6:52 (m2), and "悟りがない" in 7:18 answers it. Readable says it in everyday words.

records.literal_gloss: Nothing there is from outside the man entering into him which is able to defile him; but the things out of the man going out are the things defiling the man.

en.L: There is nothing from outside the person that enters into {{gender:them|him}} which can defile {{gender:them|him}}; but the things coming out of the person are the things that defile the person."
en.B: Nothing outside a person can make that person unclean by going in. What comes out of a person is what makes a person unclean."
en.R: Nothing that goes into people from the outside can make them unclean before God. It is the things that come out of people that make them unclean."

vi.L: Không có gì từ bên ngoài con người đi vào trong người ấy mà có thể làm người ấy ô uế; nhưng những gì từ trong con người đi ra, ấy là những điều làm con người ô uế."

vi.R: Không có gì từ bên ngoài đi vào trong người ta mà có thể làm cho họ ra ô uế trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. Chính những gì từ bên trong con người đi ra mới làm cho họ ô uế."

es.L: No hay nada fuera de la persona que, entrando en ella, pueda contaminarla; sino que lo que sale de la persona es lo que contamina a la persona».
es.B: Nada de lo que está fuera de una persona puede hacerla impura al entrar en ella. Lo que sale de la persona es lo que la hace impura».
es.R: Nada de lo que entra en la gente desde afuera puede hacerla impura ante Dios. Lo que sale de las personas es lo que las hace impuras».

fr.L: Il n’y a rien hors de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui, entrant en lui, puisse le souiller ; mais ce qui sort de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}, c’est cela qui souille {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}. »
fr.B: Rien de ce qui, venant du dehors, entre en quelqu’un ne peut le rendre impur. C’est ce qui sort de quelqu’un qui le rend impur. »
fr.R: Ce qui entre dans les gens, depuis l’extérieur, ne peut pas les rendre impurs aux yeux de Dieu. Ce qui les rend impurs, c’est ce qui sort d’eux. »

decisions.choice: defile: make common, that is, ritually unclean
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the word for the "defiled" hands of 7:2. Unclean means unfit to come before God in worship.

decisions.choice: the man: any human being
decisions.reason: The word means a person, man or woman.

decisions.choice: true uncleanness comes from within, not from food
alternatives: a teaching only about washing hands
decisions.reason: Jesus goes further than the question about hands. What enters the body cannot make a person unclean; what comes from the heart does (7:21-23). Mark draws out the meaning for food in 7:19.

decisions.choice: the SBLGNT has no verse 16
alternatives: add verse 16: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add verse 16, "If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear." It is missing from the earliest manuscripts and was most likely copied from 4:9 and 4:23, where Jesus says the same after a parable. The SBLGNT leaves it out, so the verse number 16 is skipped. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: them (him as the alternative) in Literal; a person, people in Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The saying is about every person, so the wording is inclusive.

decisions.choice: unclean before God
decisions.reason: Readable says before whom a person is unclean.

decisions.choice: "ô uế" for "defile" / "unclean", at every level
decisions.reason: "Ô uế" is uncleanness in the religious sense, which is the point (meaning decision); "dơ bẩn" would suggest dirt. The same word is used in 7:2, 7:5 and 7:18-23 so the thread of the passage stays visible.

decisions.choice: "부정하게 하다" (L, B); "하나님 앞에서 더럽게 만들다" (R) for defile, through 7:23
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the link with the "부정한 손" of 7:2, since the Greek uses the same root; Readable uses the plainer "더럽게" and says it is about standing before God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: la persona ... -la; no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "persona" is feminine whoever is meant, so the pronouns that refer to it are already inclusive and need no setting.

decisions.choice: contaminar (L); hacer impuro (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means to make ritually unclean (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps one verb throughout 7:15-23; Balanced and Readable say "hacer impuro", which ties it to the "manos impuras" of 7:2.

decisions.choice: {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} on the noun (L); no setting on the pronouns
alternatives: the setting on the pronouns, as in English
decisions.reason: French puts the gender setting on the noun the Greek has (the human being), not on the pronouns: "lui" and "le" are the same for "l’être humain" and "l’homme". Balanced and Readable say "quelqu’un" and "les gens", already inclusive. Used the same way in 7:18-23.

decisions.choice: "souiller" (L); "rendre impur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means to make common, ritually unclean (meaning decision). Literal keeps one strong verb, "souiller", for it throughout 7:15-23; Balanced and Readable say plainly "rendre impur", the opposite of "pur" in 7:19.

decisions.choice: mtu, yake (L); mtu (B, R), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: Swahili "mtu" is any person and "-ake" (his, her) has no gender, so the English span (them, him) has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ser humano|homem}} on the noun; "nele", "contaminá-lo" with no setting
alternatives: a setting on the pronouns, as in the English
decisions.reason: The English puts the setting on "them|him". Portuguese pronouns agree with the noun, so the setting goes on the noun, as in Matthew 15:11, and "nele", "-lo" follow it under both options. Balanced and Readable say "pessoa", "pessoas", which are inclusive already.

decisions.choice: "осквернить" (L); "сделать нечистым" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means to make common, ritually unclean. Literal keeps the traditional verb; Balanced and Readable say "unclean", as Matthew 15:11 does.

decisions.choice: "その人" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts its pronouns under the gender setting; Japanese "人" and "その人" already mean any person (m2), so 7:14-23 has no gender spans.

decisions.choice: "汚す" (L, B); "神の前に汚れた者にする" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is made from the word for the "defiled" hands of 7:2 (m1), and the same Japanese word is kept through 7:15-23. Readable says before whom a person is unclean, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς οἶκον ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου, ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν παραβολήν.

records.literal_gloss: And when he entered into a house from the crowd, were asking him the disciples of him the parable.

en.L: And when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} entered into a house away from the crowd, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples were asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [about] the parable.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had left the crowd and gone indoors, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about this parable.
en.R: Jesus left the crowd and went into a house. Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} what this word picture meant.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời đoàn dân vào trong một nhà, các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [về] ngụ ngôn ấy.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rời đoàn dân và vào nhà, các môn đồ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về ngụ ngôn ấy.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu rời đoàn dân và đi vào một ngôi nhà. Rồi các môn đồ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hình ảnh so sánh ấy có nghĩa là gì.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 무리를 떠나 집으로 들어가셨을 때, 그분의 제자들이 그분께 그 비유에 [대하여] 묻고 있었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 무리를 떠나 집 안으로 들어가시자, 제자들이 그 비유에 대해 여쭈었다.
ko.R: 예수께서 사람들을 떠나 어떤 집으로 들어가셨다. 그러자 제자들이 그 비유, 곧 빗대어 하신 말씀이 무슨 뜻인지 여쭈었다.

es.L: Y cuando entró en una casa, lejos de la multitud, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaban por la parábola.
es.B: Cuando dejó a la multitud y entró en una casa, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron por esa parábola.
es.R: Jesús dejó a la gente y entró en una casa. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron qué quería decir esa comparación.

fr.L: Et quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut entré dans une maison, loin de la foule, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogeaient sur la parabole.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} eut quitté la foule et fut rentré dans la maison, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogèrent sur cette parabole.
fr.R: Jésus a quitté la foule et il est entré dans une maison. Alors {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont demandé ce que voulait dire cette parole imagée.

sw.L: Na alipoingia nyumbani mbali na umati, wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa wakimwuliza [kuhusu] ule mfano.
sw.B: Alipokwisha kuuacha umati na kuingia nyumbani, wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walimwuliza maana ya mfano huo.
sw.R: Yesu aliuacha umati, akaingia ndani ya nyumba. Kisha wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakamwuliza mfano huo una maana gani.

pt.L: E, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entrou numa casa, longe da multidão, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntavam [sobre] a parábola.
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deixou a multidão e entrou em casa, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntaram sobre essa parábola.
pt.R: Jesus deixou a multidão e entrou numa casa. Então os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores perguntaram a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o que aquela comparação queria dizer.

am.L: ከሕዝቡም ተለይቶ ወደ ቤት በገባ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ [ስለ] ምሳሌው ይጠይቁት ነበር።
am.B: ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ ቤት በገባ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለዚህ ምሳሌ ጠየቁት።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ አንድ ቤት ገባ። ከዚያም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይህ ምሳሌ ምን ማለት እንደ ሆነ ጠየቁት።

ru.L: И когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вошёл в дом от толпы, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ученики спрашивали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} о притче.
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} оставил толпу и вошёл в дом, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ученики спросили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} об этой притче.
ru.R: Иисус ушёл от толпы и вошёл в дом. Тогда {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ученики спросили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, что значит эта притча.

hi.L: और जब वे भीड़ के पास से घर में गए, तो उनके चेले उनसे उस दृष्टान्त के विषय में पूछने लगे।
hi.B: जब वे भीड़ को छोड़कर घर के भीतर गए, तो उनके चेलों ने उनसे इस दृष्टान्त के बारे में पूछा।
hi.R: यीशु भीड़ को छोड़कर एक घर में गए। तब उनके चेलों ने उनसे पूछा कि इस दृष्टान्त का मतलब क्या है।

uk.L: І коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} увійшов у дім, [відійшовши] від натовпу, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} учні питали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} про притчу.
uk.B: Коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} залишив натовп і ввійшов у дім, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} учні спитали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} про цю притчу.
uk.R: Ісус залишив натовп і ввійшов у дім. Тоді {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} учні запитали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, що означає ця притча.

ja.L: そして、イエスが群衆を離れて家に入られたとき、弟子たちはそのたとえ[の意味]をイエスに尋ねていた。
ja.B: イエスが群衆を離れて家に入られると、弟子たちはこのたとえについて尋ねた。
ja.R: イエスは群衆から離れて、ある家に入られました。すると弟子たちは、このたとえはどういう意味なのかと、イエスに尋ねました。

decisions.choice: parable: a puzzling saying that needs to be explained
decisions.reason: The parable is the short saying of 7:15. The word can mean a riddle or dark saying as well as a story.

decisions.choice: into a house: away from the crowd, as in 4:10
decisions.reason: Mark does not name the house. As in 4:10-20, Jesus explains his sayings to the disciples in private.

decisions.choice: word picture
decisions.reason: Readable keeps its usual wording for a parable.

decisions.choice: "hình ảnh so sánh" (R) for this parable; "ngụ ngôn" (L, B), as in 4:2
decisions.reason: This parable is a short picture saying about food and the heart, not a story, so Readable says "hình ảnh so sánh", as in 3:23 and as the English Readable says "word picture".

decisions.choice: "여쭈었다" for the disciples asking Jesus
decisions.reason: The narrative uses the humble verb of asking for questions put to Jesus, matching the honorific "께"; Literal keeps the plainer "묻고 있었다" for the imperfect.

decisions.choice: comparación (R)
decisions.reason: As in English, Readable uses a plain word for a saying that needs explaining (meaning decision m1); Literal and Balanced keep "parábola".

decisions.choice: "cette parole imagée" (R); "la parabole" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Here the parable is a short puzzling saying (7:15), not a story (meaning decision); "parole imagée" says that plainly for new readers. "Comparaison" would not fit a saying with no comparison in it.

decisions.choice: mfano (parable) at Readable too
decisions.reason: As in Mark 3:23, "mfano" is plain enough for Readable, where the English Readable says "word picture".

decisions.choice: aquela comparação
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "word picture" for a parable. The parable here is a short saying (m1), not a story, and "comparação" is the plain Portuguese word for a saying that pictures one thing by another.

decisions.choice: "ደቀ መዛሙርት" at every level
decisions.reason: The settled Amharic word for Jesus' disciples is used at every level, Readable included, as in Matthew; it is a common word, not a church term.

decisions.choice: "ምሳሌ" at Readable too
alternatives: "የቃል ሥዕል" (word picture), as the English Readable
decisions.reason: "ምሳሌ" is the everyday Amharic word for a comparison or illustrative saying, so Readable needs no paraphrase; Readable explains instead by asking what it meant.

decisions.choice: "притча"
alternatives: "словесная картина", as the English Readable "word picture"
decisions.reason: "Притча" is the settled word at every level (style guide 7b); it is an everyday Russian word for a story or saying with a hidden meaning.

decisions.choice: "दृष्टान्त"
decisions.reason: Parable is दृष्टान्त at every level, as settled in Matthew; here the "parable" is a short puzzling saying, and Readable asks what it means.

decisions.choice: "たとえ" at every level
decisions.reason: The Gospel terms keep "たとえ" at every level for parable; Readable asks what it meant, since this parable is a short puzzling saying (m1).

source.text: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀσύνετοί ἐστε;

records.literal_gloss: And he says to them, Thus also you without understanding are?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to them, "Are you also so without understanding?
en.B: He said to them, "Are even you so slow to understand?
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Do even you not understand this?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các con cũng thiếu hiểu biết như vậy sao?
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Ngay cả các con mà cũng chậm hiểu như thế sao?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ngay cả các con cũng không hiểu điều này sao?

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하신다. "너희도 이렇게 깨닫지 못하느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희조차 이렇게 깨닫지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희도 이것을 깨닫지 못하느냐?

es.L: Y les dice: «¿Así que también {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} sin entendimiento?
es.B: Les dijo: «¿Hasta {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} tan lentos para entender?
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «¿Ni siquiera {{plural_you:ustedes entienden|vosotros entendéis}} esto?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Vous aussi, vous êtes ainsi sans intelligence ?
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Même vous, vous êtes si lents à comprendre ?
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Même vous, vous ne comprenez pas cela ?

sw.L: Naye anawaambia, "Je, hata ninyi mko hivyo bila ufahamu?
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Je, hata ninyi ni wazito hivyo wa kuelewa?
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Je, hata ninyi hamwelewi jambo hili?

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes diz: "Assim também vocês estão sem entendimento?
pt.B: Ele lhes disse: "Até vocês custam tanto a entender?
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Nem vocês entendem isso?

am.L: እንዲህም ይላቸዋል፦ «እናንተም ደግሞ እንዲሁ የማታስተውሉ ናችሁን?
am.B: እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «እናንተ እንኳ ለማስተዋል እንዲህ ትዘገያላችሁን?
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እናንተም እንኳ ይህ አልገባችሁም?

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит им: «Неужели и вы так непонятливы?
ru.B: Он сказал им: «Неужели даже вы так плохо понимаете?
ru.R: Иисус сказал им: «Неужели даже вы этого не понимаете?

hi.L: और वे उनसे कहते हैं, "क्या तुम भी ऐसे नासमझ हो?
hi.B: उन्होंने उनसे कहा, "क्या तुम भी समझने में इतने धीमे हो?
hi.R: यीशु ने उनसे कहा, "क्या तुम भी यह नहीं समझते?

uk.L: І каже їм: «Так і ви нетямущі?
uk.B: Він сказав їм: «Невже й ви такі нетямущі?
uk.R: Ісус сказав їм: «Невже й ви цього не розумієте?

ja.L: すると、イエスは彼らに言われる。「あなたがたも、それほど悟りがないのか？
ja.B: イエスは彼らに言われた。「あなたがたまで、そんなに物分かりが悪いのか？
ja.R: イエスは彼らに言われました。「あなたたちまで、これが分からないのか？

decisions.choice: without understanding: unable to grasp the meaning
decisions.reason: The word answers 7:14, where Jesus called everyone to understand. The disciples are no quicker than the crowd (6:52; 8:17).

decisions.choice: a question that rebukes
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates the words as a question. Jesus is surprised that his own followers need an explanation.

decisions.choice: "các con" for the disciples
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to his disciples, as in the Vietnamese John; the scene has moved from the crowd ("các người") into the house.

decisions.choice: "言われる" (L); "言われた" (B); "言われました" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's historic present: Literal keeps the present, as it does through 7:14-23; Balanced and Readable narrate in the past.

source.text: οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἔξωθεν εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς τὸν ἄνθρωπον οὐ δύναται αὐτὸν κοινῶσαι, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσπορεύεται αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἀλλ’ εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν, καὶ εἰς τὸν ἀφεδρῶνα ἐκπορεύεται;

records.literal_gloss: Not you understand that everything from outside entering into the man not is able him to defile, \v 19 because not it enters of him into the heart but into the belly, and into the latrine goes out?

en.L: Do you not perceive that everything entering into the person from outside cannot defile {{gender:them|him}}, \v 19 because it does not enter into {{gender:their|his}} heart but into the belly, and goes out into the latrine?"
en.B: Do you not see that nothing that goes into a person from outside can make that person unclean? \v 19 It does not go into the heart but into the stomach, and from there it goes out into the latrine."
en.R: Do you not see? Nothing that goes into people from the outside can make them unclean. \v 19 It does not go into their hearts. It goes into their stomachs, and then it goes out of their bodies into the toilet."

vi.L: Các con không nhận biết rằng mọi thứ từ bên ngoài đi vào trong con người không thể làm người ấy ô uế sao, \v 19 vì nó không đi vào lòng người ấy nhưng vào bụng, rồi đi ra nơi hố xí?"
vi.B: Các con không thấy rằng không có gì từ bên ngoài đi vào một người mà có thể làm người ấy ô uế sao? \v 19 Vì nó không đi vào lòng mà vào bụng, rồi từ đó ra nơi hố xí."
vi.R: Các con không thấy sao? Không có gì từ bên ngoài đi vào trong người ta mà có thể làm cho họ ô uế. \v 19 Nó không đi vào lòng họ. Nó đi vào bụng, rồi ra khỏi cơ thể, xuống nhà vệ sinh."

ko.L: 밖에서 사람 안으로 들어가는 모든 것이 그를 부정하게 할 수 없다는 것을 알지 못하느냐? \v 19 그것이 그의 마음으로 들어가지 않고 배로 들어갔다가 뒷간으로 나가기 때문이다."
ko.B: 밖에서 사람 안으로 들어가는 것은 무엇이든 그 사람을 부정하게 할 수 없다는 것을 모르겠느냐? \v 19 그것은 마음으로 들어가지 않고 배로 들어갔다가, 변소로 나간다."
ko.R: 모르겠느냐? 밖에서 사람의 몸속으로 들어가는 것은 사람을 더럽게 만들 수 없다. \v 19 그것은 사람의 마음으로 들어가지 않는다. 배 속으로 들어갔다가 몸 밖으로 나가 화장실로 빠져나간다."

es.L: ¿No {{plural_you:comprenden|comprendéis}} que todo lo que entra en la persona desde fuera no puede contaminarla, \v 19 porque no entra en su corazón, sino en el vientre, y sale a la letrina?».
es.B: ¿No {{plural_you:ven|veis}} que nada de lo que entra en una persona desde fuera puede hacerla impura? \v 19 No entra en el corazón, sino en el estómago, y de ahí sale a la letrina».
es.R: ¿No lo {{plural_you:ven|veis}}? Nada de lo que entra en la gente desde afuera puede hacerla impura. \v 19 No entra en su corazón. Entra en su estómago, y después sale del cuerpo y va a parar a la letrina».

fr.L: Ne saisissez-vous pas que tout ce qui, du dehors, entre dans {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} ne peut pas le souiller, \v 19 parce que cela n’entre pas dans son cœur, mais dans le ventre, et s’en va dans les latrines ? »
fr.B: Ne voyez-vous pas que rien de ce qui entre du dehors en quelqu’un ne peut le rendre impur ? \v 19 Cela ne va pas dans le cœur, mais dans le ventre, et ensuite part aux latrines. »
fr.R: Vous ne comprenez pas ? Rien de ce qui entre dans les gens depuis l’extérieur ne peut les rendre impurs. \v 19 Cela ne va pas dans leur cœur. Cela va dans leur ventre, et ensuite cela sort de leur corps et va aux toilettes. »

sw.L: Je, hamtambui kwamba kila kitu kinachoingia ndani ya mtu kutoka nje hakiwezi kumtia unajisi, \v 19 kwa sababu hakiingii moyoni mwake bali tumboni, na kinatoka kwenda chooni?"
sw.B: Je, hamwoni kwamba hakuna kitu kinachoingia ndani ya mtu kutoka nje kinachoweza kumfanya najisi? \v 19 Hakiingii moyoni mwake bali tumboni, na kutoka hapo kinatoka nje chooni."
sw.R: Je, hamwoni? Hakuna kitu kinachoingia ndani ya mtu kutoka nje kinachoweza kumfanya najisi. \v 19 Chakula hakiingii moyoni mwake. Kinaingia tumboni, kisha kinatoka mwilini na kwenda chooni."

pt.L: Não percebem que tudo o que de fora entra no {{gender:ser humano|homem}} não pode contaminá-lo, \v 19 porque não entra no coração dele, mas no ventre, e sai para a fossa?"
pt.B: Não percebem que nada do que entra numa pessoa, vindo de fora, pode torná-la impura? \v 19 Não entra no coração, mas no estômago, e de lá sai para a fossa."
pt.R: Vocês não percebem? Nada que entra nas pessoas, vindo de fora, pode deixá-las impuras. \v 19 Não entra no coração delas. Vai para o estômago e depois sai do corpo para a privada."

am.L: ከውጭ ወደ ሰው የሚገባ ሁሉ ሊያረክሰው እንደማይችል አታስተውሉምን? \v 19 ወደ ሆድ እንጂ ወደ ልቡ አይገባምና፤ ወደ መጸዳጃም ይወጣል።»
am.B: ከውጭ ወደ ሰው የሚገባ ምንም ነገር ሰውን ሊያረክስ እንደማይችል አትገነዘቡምን? \v 19 ወደ ሆድ እንጂ ወደ ልብ አይገባም፤ ከዚያም ወደ መጸዳጃ ይወጣል።»
am.R: አልገባችሁም? ከውጭ ወደ ሰው የሚገባ ምንም ነገር ሰውን ሊያረክሰው አይችልም። \v 19 ወደ ልቡ አይገባም። ወደ ሆዱ ይገባል፤ ከዚያም ከሰውነቱ ወጥቶ ወደ መጸዳጃ ይሄዳል።»

ru.L: Не понимаете, что всё, входящее в человека извне, не может осквернить его, \v 19 потому что входит не в сердце его, а в чрево, и выходит вон в отхожее место?»
ru.B: Разве вы не видите, что ничто, попадая в человека снаружи, не может сделать его нечистым? \v 19 Ведь оно попадает не в сердце, а в желудок, а потом выходит вон, в отхожее место.»
ru.R: Разве вы не видите? Ничто, что попадает в людей снаружи, не может сделать их нечистыми. \v 19 Оно попадает не в их сердца. Оно попадает в желудок, а потом выходит из тела в уборную.»

hi.L: क्या तुम नहीं समझते कि जो कुछ बाहर से मनुष्य के भीतर जाता है, वह उसे अशुद्ध नहीं कर सकता, \v 19 क्योंकि वह उसके हृदय में नहीं, बल्कि पेट में जाता है, और शौचालय में निकल जाता है?"
hi.B: क्या तुम नहीं देखते कि जो कुछ बाहर से मनुष्य के भीतर जाता है, वह उसे अशुद्ध नहीं कर सकता? \v 19 वह हृदय में नहीं, बल्कि पेट में जाता है, और वहाँ से शौचालय में निकल जाता है।"
hi.R: क्या तुम देखते नहीं? जो कुछ बाहर से लोगों के भीतर जाता है, वह उन्हें अशुद्ध नहीं बना सकता। \v 19 वह उनके दिल में नहीं जाता। वह उनके पेट में जाता है, और फिर शरीर से बाहर निकलकर शौचालय में चला जाता है।"

uk.L: Хіба не розумієте, що все, що входить ззовні в людину, не може її осквернити, \v 19 бо входить не в її серце, а в черево, і виходить у відхідок?»
uk.B: Хіба ви не бачите, що ніщо, що ззовні входить у людину, не може зробити її нечистою? \v 19 Воно ж іде не в серце, а в шлунок, а звідти виходить у відхідок.»
uk.R: Хіба ви не бачите? Ніщо, що потрапляє в людину ззовні, не може зробити її нечистою. \v 19 Воно не потрапляє в її серце. Воно потрапляє в шлунок, а потім виходить із тіла у вбиральню.»

ja.L: 外から人の中に入って来るものはすべて、その人を汚すことができないと、分からないのか？\v 19 それはその人の心に入らず、腹に入り、そして便所へ出て行くのだから。」
ja.B: 外から人の中に入るものは何一つ人を汚すことができないと、分からないのか？\v 19 それは心の中に入るのではなく、腹に入り、そこから便所へ出て行くのだ。」
ja.R: 分からないのか？外から人の中に入るものは、人を汚れた者にすることはできない。\v 19 それは心の中には入らない。おなかに入り、それから体の外に出て、トイレへ行くのだ。」

decisions.choice: heart: the inner self, the center of thought and will
decisions.reason: Food goes into the stomach, not into the heart where a person's choices are made (7:21).

decisions.choice: latrine: the place where waste goes
decisions.reason: The word means a privy or toilet. Jesus speaks plainly: food passes through the body and out of it.

decisions.choice: do you not perceive: a question that expects the answer yes
decisions.reason: Jesus states what they ought to have seen for themselves.

decisions.choice: toilet
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "뒷간" (L); "변소" (B); "화장실" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is plain but not crude; the older words suit the ancient setting at Literal and Balanced, and Readable uses the everyday word, as the English Readable says "toilet".

decisions.choice: chooni (into the latrine) at every level
decisions.reason: "Choo" is the ordinary Swahili word for a latrine or toilet and is not coarse, so every level can keep the Greek picture.

decisions.choice: a fossa (L, B); a privada (R)
decisions.reason: "Latrina" is rare in Brazil; "fossa" is the pit where waste goes, as in Matthew 15:17, and Readable says "privada", the everyday word, as the English Readable says "toilet".

decisions.choice: the question mark placed after "分からないのか", before verse 19
alternatives: "……出て行くのだから、分からないのか？" at the end
decisions.reason: In the Greek the question runs to the end of verse 19. Putting "分からないのか" last in Japanese would move verse 18's verb after verse 19, so the question closes at the end of verse 18 and verse 19 gives the reason after it.

source.text: καθαρίζων πάντα τὰ βρώματα.

records.literal_gloss: cleansing all the foods.

en.L: [In this {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was] making all foods clean.
en.B: By saying this, Jesus made all foods clean.
en.R: When Jesus said this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was making all foods clean. People could eat any kind of food.

vi.L: [Nói như vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] làm cho mọi thức ăn được sạch.
vi.B: Nói như vậy, Đức Giê-xu làm cho mọi thức ăn đều trở nên sạch.
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu nói điều này, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho mọi thức ăn đều sạch. Người ta có thể ăn bất cứ loại thức ăn nào.

ko.L: [이렇게 말씀하심으로 그분은] 모든 음식을 깨끗하게 하셨다.
ko.B: 이렇게 말씀하심으로써 예수께서는 모든 음식을 깨끗하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 이렇게 말씀하셔서 모든 음식을 깨끗하게 하셨다. 이제 사람들은 어떤 음식이든 먹을 수 있게 되었다.

es.L: [Con esto] declaraba limpios todos los alimentos.
es.B: Al decir esto, Jesús declaró limpios todos los alimentos.
es.R: Cuando Jesús dijo esto, estaba declarando limpios todos los alimentos. La gente podía comer cualquier clase de comida.

fr.L: [Par là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}] rendait purs tous les aliments.
fr.B: En disant cela, Jésus rendait purs tous les aliments.
fr.R: Quand Jésus a dit cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu purs tous les aliments. On pouvait manger toutes sortes de nourriture.

sw.L: [Kwa kusema hivyo alikuwa] akivitakasa vyakula vyote.
sw.B: Kwa kusema hivyo, Yesu alivifanya vyakula vyote kuwa safi.
sw.R: Yesu aliposema hivyo, alikuwa akivifanya vyakula vyote kuwa safi. Watu wangeweza kula chakula cha aina yoyote.

pt.L: [Com isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estava] purificando todos os alimentos.
pt.B: Ao dizer isso, Jesus declarou puros todos os alimentos.
pt.R: Quando Jesus disse isso, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estava declarando que todos os alimentos são puros. As pessoas podiam comer qualquer tipo de comida.

am.L: [በዚህም] ምግቦችን ሁሉ ንጹሕ እያደረገ [ነበር]።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ይህን በመናገሩ ምግቦችን ሁሉ ንጹሕ አደረገ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ይህን ሲናገር ምግቦችን ሁሉ ንጹሕ እያደረገ ነበር። ሰዎች ማንኛውንም ምግብ መብላት ይችላሉ ማለት ነው።

ru.L: [Этим {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}] делал чистой всякую пищу.
ru.B: Этими словами Иисус сделал всякую пищу чистой.
ru.R: Когда Иисус сказал это, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сделал чистой всякую пищу. Люди могли есть любую еду.

hi.L: [यह कहकर वे] सब भोजन-वस्तुओं को शुद्ध ठहरा रहे थे।
hi.B: यह कहकर यीशु ने सब प्रकार के भोजन को शुद्ध ठहराया।
hi.R: जब यीशु ने यह कहा, तो वे सब तरह के खाने को शुद्ध ठहरा रहे थे। अब लोग हर तरह का खाना खा सकते थे।

uk.L: [Цим {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}] робив чистими всі страви.
uk.B: Цими словами Ісус оголосив чистою будь-яку їжу.
uk.R: Коли Ісус сказав це, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} робив чистою всю їжу. Люди могли їсти будь-яку їжу.

ja.L: [こう言って、イエスは]すべての食べ物を清いものとされた。
ja.B: こう言って、イエスはすべての食べ物を清いものとされた。
ja.R: イエスはこう言って、すべての食べ物を清いものとされたのです。どんな食べ物でも食べてよいことになったのです。

decisions.choice: making clean: Mark's comment on Jesus' words, with Jesus as the one who makes clean
alternatives: the digestive process cleans the food
decisions.reason: The word is a participle that is masculine and goes with the speaker of 7:18, "he says". It cannot go with the latrine or with the food that enters. So it is Mark's own note: by this teaching Jesus declared all foods clean. Older translations read it as part of Jesus' words, about the body purging food.

decisions.choice: making clean, a masculine form, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: a neuter form, linking the words to the process of digestion
decisions.reason: Some later manuscripts have a neuter form, which ties the words to what goes on in the body. The earliest manuscripts have the masculine form. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: all foods clean: the food laws no longer decide who is clean before God
alternatives: only food eaten with unwashed hands
decisions.reason: The food laws of Leviticus 11 separated clean from unclean animals. Mark sees in Jesus' words that this division is now ended. The same verb is used in Peter's vision, "what God has made clean" (Acts 10:15; compare Romans 14:14, 20).

decisions.choice: a sentence of its own, set apart from Jesus' words
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT closes Jesus' question at "goes out into the latrine" and sets these words apart as Mark's comment.

decisions.choice: [In this he was] (L); By saying this, Jesus (B); When Jesus said this (R)
alternatives: cleansing all foods, with no subject
decisions.reason: English needs a subject and must show that this is the writer's comment, not Jesus' words.

decisions.choice: People could eat any kind of food
decisions.reason: Readable says what making all foods clean meant in practice.

decisions.choice: declarar limpios
decisions.reason: Spanish "purificar" could be read as the body cleaning the food, the reading the meaning decisions set aside (m1); "declarar limpios" keeps Jesus as the one who makes the foods clean. Literal brackets "Con esto", since the Greek has only the participle.

decisions.choice: akivitakasa (L); alivifanya ... kuwa safi (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Safi" is the opposite of "najisi" in the ritual sense used through this passage. "Kuhalalisha" (make lawful) would bring in the language of halal food, which is close but narrower than clean and unclean before God.

decisions.choice: declarou puros (B); estava declarando que todos os alimentos são puros (R)
decisions.reason: "Purificar os alimentos" in Portuguese could suggest cleaning the food itself. Balanced and Readable say what Jesus did by his words (m1, m3): he declared them clean. Literal keeps the verb "purificando".

decisions.choice: "[Этим он] делал чистой"
decisions.reason: A Russian participle here would attach to the food going out, not to Jesus; Literal supplies the subject in brackets so that the sentence reads as Mark's comment on Jesus' words.

decisions.choice: "清いものとされた", with the respect form
decisions.reason: These words are Mark's comment, and Jesus is the one who makes the foods clean (m1), so the narrator's respect form for Jesus is used, which also shows that they are not part of Jesus' words.

source.text: ἔλεγεν δὲ ὅτι Τὸ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκεῖνο κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον·

records.literal_gloss: He was saying and that, That which out of the man going out, that defiles the man.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying, "What comes out of the person, that defiles the person.
en.B: He went on, "What comes out of a person is what makes a person unclean.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "It is what comes out of people that makes them unclean.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Điều từ trong con người đi ra, chính điều ấy làm con người ô uế.
vi.B: Ngài nói tiếp: "Chính điều từ trong một người đi ra mới làm cho người ấy ô uế.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Chính những gì từ bên trong người ta đi ra mới làm cho họ ô uế.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 말씀하셨다. "사람에게서 나오는 것, 그것이 사람을 부정하게 한다.
ko.B: 예수께서 말씀을 이으셨다. "사람에게서 나오는 것이 사람을 부정하게 한다.
ko.R: 예수께서 또 말씀하셨다. "사람을 더럽게 만드는 것은 사람에게서 나오는 것이다.

es.L: Y decía: «Lo que sale de la persona, eso contamina a la persona.
es.B: Y siguió diciendo: «Lo que sale de la persona es lo que la hace impura.
es.R: Luego dijo: «Lo que sale de las personas es lo que las hace impuras.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait : « Ce qui sort de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}, c’est cela qui souille {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}.
fr.B: Il poursuivit : « C’est ce qui sort de quelqu’un qui le rend impur.
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit : « C’est ce qui sort des gens qui les rend impurs.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akisema, "Kile kinachotoka ndani ya mtu, hicho ndicho kinachomtia mtu unajisi.
sw.B: Akaendelea kusema, "Kinachotoka ndani ya mtu ndicho kinachomfanya mtu najisi.
sw.R: Kisha akasema, "Ni yale yanayotoka ndani ya mtu ndiyo yanayomfanya najisi.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dizia: "O que sai do {{gender:ser humano|homem}}, isso contamina o {{gender:ser humano|homem}}.
pt.B: Ele continuou: "O que sai de uma pessoa é que torna a pessoa impura.
pt.R: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "O que deixa as pessoas impuras é o que sai delas.

am.L: እንዲህም ይል ነበር፦ «ከሰው የሚወጣው፣ ያ ሰውን ያረክሳል።
am.B: ቀጥሎም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ከሰው የሚወጣው ነው።
am.R: ከዚያም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ሰዎችን የሚያረክሰው ከእነርሱ የሚወጣው ነገር ነው።

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорил: «Выходящее из человека — то оскверняет человека.
ru.B: Он продолжал: «Нечистым человека делает то, что выходит из него.
ru.R: Потом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал: «Нечистыми людей делает то, что выходит из них.

hi.L: और उन्होंने कहा, "जो मनुष्य में से निकलता है, वही मनुष्य को अशुद्ध करता है।
hi.B: उन्होंने आगे कहा, "जो मनुष्य के भीतर से निकलता है, वही मनुष्य को अशुद्ध करता है।
hi.R: फिर उन्होंने कहा, "जो लोगों के भीतर से निकलता है, वही उन्हें अशुद्ध बनाता है।

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} казав: «Те, що виходить із людини, те оскверняє людину.
uk.B: Він сказав далі: «Що виходить із людини, те й робить людину нечистою.
uk.R: Потім {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав: «Людину робить нечистою те, що виходить із неї.

ja.L: また、イエスは言っておられた。「人から出て来るもの、それが人を汚すのである。
ja.B: イエスはさらに言われた。「人から出て来るものこそ、人を汚すのである。
ja.R: それからイエスは言われました。「人を汚れた者にするのは、人の中から出て来るものだ。

decisions.choice: that defiles: the word "that" stresses what comes out
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats the second half of 7:15 and goes on to explain it.

decisions.choice: he was saying: Jesus continues speaking to the disciples
decisions.reason: The imperfect continues the private teaching in the house.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ser humano|homem}}
alternatives: a pessoa, with no setting, as the English Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun it uses for the same saying in 7:15, 7:18 and 7:23, under the same setting, so that the repeated word stays the same through the passage; the English Literal says "the person" here and needs no setting.

source.text: ἔσωθεν γὰρ ἐκ τῆς καρδίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων οἱ διαλογισμοὶ οἱ κακοὶ ἐκπορεύονται, πορνεῖαι, κλοπαί, φόνοι, μοιχεῖαι, πλεονεξίαι, πονηρίαι, δόλος, ἀσέλγεια, ὀφθαλμὸς πονηρός, βλασφημία, ὑπερηφανία, ἀφροσύνη·

records.literal_gloss: From within for out of the heart of the men the thoughts the evil go out, sexual immoralities, thefts, murders, \v 22 adulteries, covetings, wickednesses, deceit, sensuality, eye evil, slander, pride, foolishness;

en.L: For from within, out of the heart of {{gender:people|men}}, come the evil thoughts, sexual immoralities, thefts, murders, \v 22 adulteries, greedy desires, wickednesses, deceit, sensuality, an evil eye, slander, pride, foolishness;
en.B: Out of the human heart, from within, come evil designs, sexual sin, theft, murder, \v 22 adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, indecency, envy, slander, pride, and moral folly.
en.R: Evil things come from inside a person, from the heart. These include evil plans, sexual sin, stealing, and murder. \v 22 They also include adultery, greed, doing harm to others, lying and cheating, shameless living, jealousy, saying evil things about others, pride, and living like a fool.

vi.L: Vì từ bên trong, từ lòng của loài người, phát ra những ý tưởng xấu xa, những sự gian dâm, trộm cắp, giết người, \v 22 ngoại tình, tham lam, gian ác, lừa dối, phóng đãng, con mắt ác, phỉ báng, kiêu ngạo, ngu dại;
vi.B: Vì từ bên trong, từ lòng người, phát ra những mưu tính xấu xa, gian dâm, trộm cắp, giết người, \v 22 ngoại tình, tham lam, gian ác, lừa dối, trác táng, ganh tị, phỉ báng, kiêu căng và ngu muội.
vi.R: Những điều xấu xa đến từ bên trong con người, từ trong lòng. Đó là những ý định xấu, tội tình dục, trộm cắp và giết người. \v 22 Đó còn là ngoại tình, tham lam, làm hại người khác, nói dối và lừa gạt, sống buông thả không biết xấu hổ, ganh ghét, nói xấu người khác, kiêu ngạo, và sống như kẻ dại dột.

ko.L: 왜냐하면 안에서, 곧 사람들의 마음에서 악한 생각들이 나오기 때문이다. [곧] 음행들, 도둑질들, 살인들, \v 22 간음들, 탐욕들, 악행들, 속임수, 방탕, 악한 눈, 비방, 교만, 어리석음이다.
ko.B: 사람의 마음속에서 악한 생각이 나오고, 음행과 도둑질과 살인과 \v 22 간음과 탐욕과 악의와 속임수와 방탕과 시기와 비방과 교만과 어리석음이 나온다.
ko.R: 악한 것들은 사람의 속, 곧 마음에서 나온다. 악한 계획, 성적인 죄, 도둑질, 살인 같은 것들이다. \v 22 또 간음, 욕심, 남을 해치는 일, 거짓말과 속임수, 부끄러운 줄 모르는 생활, 질투, 남을 헐뜯는 말, 교만, 어리석은 생활 같은 것들이다.

es.L: Porque de dentro, del corazón de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}, salen los malos pensamientos, inmoralidades sexuales, robos, homicidios, \v 22 adulterios, codicias, maldades, engaño, desenfreno, ojo maligno, calumnia, soberbia, insensatez;
es.B: Porque de dentro, del corazón humano, salen los malos propósitos, la inmoralidad sexual, los robos, los homicidios, \v 22 los adulterios, la avaricia, la maldad, el engaño, el libertinaje, la envidia, la calumnia, la soberbia y la necedad.
es.R: Las cosas malas salen de adentro de la persona, del corazón. Entre ellas están los malos planes, el pecado sexual, el robo y el asesinato. \v 22 También el adulterio, la avaricia, hacer daño a los demás, mentir y engañar, vivir sin vergüenza, la envidia, hablar mal de los demás, el orgullo y vivir como un necio.

fr.L: Car du dedans, du cœur {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}, sortent les pensées mauvaises, immoralités sexuelles, vols, meurtres, \v 22 adultères, convoitises, méchancetés, ruse, débauche, œil mauvais, calomnie, orgueil, folie ;
fr.B: Car c’est du dedans, du cœur humain, que viennent les mauvais desseins : l’immoralité sexuelle, le vol, le meurtre, \v 22 l’adultère, la cupidité, la méchanceté, la ruse, l’indécence, l’envie, la calomnie, l’orgueil et la déraison.
fr.R: Les choses mauvaises viennent de l’intérieur d’une personne, de son cœur. Ce sont les projets mauvais, les péchés sexuels, le vol et le meurtre. \v 22 Il y a aussi l’adultère, l’avidité, le mal qu’on fait aux autres, le mensonge et la tricherie, la vie sans retenue, la jalousie, les paroles méchantes contre les autres, l’orgueil et une vie sans sagesse.

sw.L: Kwa maana kutoka ndani, katika moyo wa wanadamu, hutoka mawazo maovu, uasherati, wizi, mauaji, \v 22 uzinzi, tamaa za kupata zaidi, maovu, udanganyifu, ufisadi, jicho ovu, masingizio, kiburi, upumbavu;
sw.B: Kutoka ndani ya moyo wa mwanadamu hutoka mipango mibaya, uasherati, wizi, mauaji, \v 22 uzinzi, tamaa, uovu, udanganyifu, tabia isiyo na aibu, husuda, masingizio, majivuno, na upumbavu.
sw.R: Mambo mabaya hutoka ndani ya mtu, moyoni mwake. Mambo hayo ni pamoja na mipango mibaya, dhambi za uasherati, wizi na mauaji. \v 22 Ni pamoja pia na uzinzi, tamaa ya mali, kuwatendea wengine mabaya, uongo na hila, maisha yasiyo na aibu, wivu, kuwasema wengine vibaya, kiburi, na kuishi kama mpumbavu.

pt.L: Pois de dentro, do coração {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}}, saem os maus pensamentos, imoralidades sexuais, roubos, homicídios, \v 22 adultérios, cobiças, maldades, engano, libertinagem, olho mau, calúnia, soberba, insensatez;
pt.B: Pois é de dentro, do coração humano, que vêm os planos maldosos, a imoralidade sexual, o roubo, o homicídio, \v 22 o adultério, a ganância, a maldade, o engano, a indecência, a inveja, a calúnia, o orgulho e a insensatez.
pt.R: As coisas más vêm de dentro da pessoa, do coração. Entre elas estão os planos maldosos, os pecados sexuais, o roubo e o assassinato. \v 22 Também estão o adultério, a ganância, o mal feito aos outros, a mentira e a trapaça, a vida sem vergonha, a inveja, as palavras maldosas contra os outros, o orgulho e a vida de quem age como um tolo.

am.L: ከውስጥ፣ ከሰዎች ልብ፣ ክፉ ሐሳቦች ይወጣሉና፤ ዝሙቶች፣ ስርቆቶች፣ ግድያዎች፣ \v 22 ምንዝርናዎች፣ ስግብግብነቶች፣ ክፋቶች፣ ተንኮል፣ ብልግና፣ ክፉ ዓይን፣ ስድብ፣ ትዕቢት፣ ሞኝነት፤
am.B: ከውስጥ፣ ከሰው ልብ ክፉ ዕቅድ ይወጣልና፤ ዝሙት፣ ስርቆት፣ ነፍስ ግድያ፣ \v 22 ምንዝርና፣ ስግብግብነት፣ ክፋት፣ ተንኮል፣ ብልግና፣ ምቀኝነት፣ ስድብ፣ ትዕቢትና ሞኝነትም ይወጣሉ።
am.R: ክፉ ነገሮች የሚወጡት ከሰው ውስጥ፣ ከልቡ ነው። ከእነዚህም መካከል ክፉ ዕቅድ፣ የዝሙት ኃጢአት፣ መስረቅና ነፍስ መግደል ይገኙበታል። \v 22 ደግሞም ምንዝርና፣ ስግብግብነት፣ ሌሎችን መጉዳት፣ መዋሸትና ማታለል፣ ያለ እፍረት መኖር፣ ቅናት፣ በሌሎች ላይ ክፉ መናገር፣ ትዕቢትና እንደ ሞኝ መኖር ይገኙበታል።

ru.L: Ведь изнутри, из сердца людей, исходят злые помыслы, блуд, кражи, убийства, \v 22 прелюбодеяния, корысть, злоба, коварство, распутство, дурной глаз, клевета, гордость, безрассудство;
ru.B: Ведь изнутри, из человеческого сердца, выходят злые замыслы, блуд, воровство, убийство, \v 22 супружеская измена, жадность, злоба, обман, распущенность, зависть, клевета, гордыня и безрассудство.
ru.R: Злое выходит изнутри человека, из сердца. Это злые замыслы, сексуальные грехи, воровство и убийство. \v 22 Это также измена мужу или жене, жадность, желание навредить другим, ложь и обман, бесстыдная жизнь, зависть, злые слова о других, гордость и жизнь, как у глупца.

hi.L: क्योंकि भीतर से, मनुष्यों के हृदय से, बुरे विचार निकलते हैं, यौन अनैतिकताएँ, चोरियाँ, हत्याएँ, \v 22 व्यभिचार, लोभ, दुष्टताएँ, छल, लुचपन, बुरी दृष्टि, निंदा, घमंड, मूर्खता;
hi.B: मनुष्य के हृदय से, भीतर से ही, बुरी योजनाएँ निकलती हैं, और यौन पाप, चोरी, हत्या, \v 22 व्यभिचार, लोभ, दुष्टता, छल, निर्लज्जता, जलन, निंदा, घमंड और मूर्खता भी।
hi.R: बुरी बातें इंसान के भीतर से, उसके दिल से आती हैं। इनमें बुरी योजनाएँ, यौन पाप, चोरी और हत्या शामिल हैं। \v 22 इनमें व्यभिचार, लालच, दूसरों का बुरा करना, झूठ और धोखा, बेशर्मी से जीना, जलन, दूसरों के बारे में बुरी बातें कहना, घमंड और मूर्खों की तरह जीना भी शामिल हैं।

uk.L: Бо зсередини, із серця людського, виходять лихі думки, блудодіяння, крадіжки, вбивства, \v 22 перелюби, зажерливості, лукавства, підступ, безсоромність, лихе око, наклеп, пиха, безумство;
uk.B: Бо зсередини, з людського серця, виходять лихі задуми, розпуста, крадіжки, вбивства, \v 22 перелюб, жадібність, злоба, підступ, безсоромність, заздрість, наклеп, гордість і нерозумність.
uk.R: Лихе виходить зсередини людини, із серця. Це лихі задуми, розпуста, крадіжки й убивства. \v 22 Це також перелюб, жадібність, бажання шкодити іншим, брехня й ошуканство, безсоромне життя, заздрість, лихі слова про інших, гордість і безглузде життя.

ja.L: 内から、すなわち人々の心から、悪い考え、淫らな行い、盗み、殺人、\v 22 姦淫、貪欲、悪意、欺き、好色、悪い目、悪口、高慢、愚かさが出て来るからである。
ja.B: 人の心の中から、内側から出て来るのは、悪い企み、淫らな行い、盗み、殺人、\v 22 姦淫、貪欲、悪意、欺き、恥知らずな行い、ねたみ、悪口、高慢、愚かさである。
ja.R: 悪いものは、人の中から、心から出て来る。それは、悪い計画、性的な罪、盗み、人殺し、\v 22 それに、不倫、欲張り、人を傷つけること、うそやごまかし、恥ずかしいことを平気ですること、ねたみ、人の悪口を言うこと、高ぶり、愚か者のように生きることだ。

decisions.choice: evil thoughts, then twelve evils: six acts in the plural, six traits in the singular
alternatives: evil thoughts as a heading for all that follow
decisions.reason: Evil thoughts come first, as the root. The plurals name deeds done again and again; the singulars name attitudes of the heart.

decisions.choice: sexual immorality: any sexual sin outside marriage
decisions.reason: The word is broad. Adultery, breaking one's own marriage, is named separately.

decisions.choice: an evil eye: envy, grudging meanness
alternatives: putting a curse by a look
decisions.reason: In Scripture an evil eye looks with envy or refuses to give (Deuteronomy 15:9; Proverbs 28:22; Matthew 20:15).

decisions.choice: slander: speaking evil of others, and perhaps of God
decisions.reason: The word means abusive speech. In a list of wrongs done to others it most likely means slander, though it is also used for speaking against God (3:28-29).

decisions.choice: sensuality: shameless, unrestrained living; foolishness: moral folly
decisions.reason: The fool in Scripture is the one who lives as though there were no God (Psalm 14:1).

decisions.choice: lying and cheating, shameless living, jealousy, saying evil things about others, living like a fool
alternatives: deceit, sensuality, an evil eye, slander, foolishness
decisions.reason: Readable puts the list into plain words, and explains the evil eye as jealousy.

decisions.choice: "con mắt ác" (L); "ganh tị" (B); "ganh ghét" (R) for "an evil eye"
alternatives: "con mắt gian ác" at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture; Vietnamese has no such idiom, so Balanced and Readable give its sense, envy (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Literal marks the first six evils with the plural "-들" and leaves the last six singular
alternatives: no plural marking, as in Balanced
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes six acts in the plural and six traits in the singular; Korean rarely marks plural on such nouns, so Literal uses "-들" only to keep that distinction visible.

decisions.choice: "악한 눈" (L); "시기" (B); "질투" (R)
decisions.reason: Korean has no idiom of the evil eye for envy, so Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: ojo maligno (L); envidia (B, R)
decisions.reason: "An evil eye" means envy and grudging meanness (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps the picture; in Spanish "mal de ojo" would mean a curse, so Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "la déraison" (B); "une vie sans sagesse" (R); "folie" (L)
decisions.reason: The word means moral folly, a life without sense before God (meaning decision). Alone, French "folie" now suggests madness and "sottise" mere silliness; Literal keeps "folie" as the word the reader will recognise.

decisions.choice: jicho ovu (L); husuda (B); wivu (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "an evil eye" as envy. Literal keeps the picture; Balanced says "husuda" (grudging envy) and Readable the everyday "wivu".

decisions.choice: "ክፉ ዓይን" (L); "ምቀኝነት" (envy, B)
